name: 3M | Telegram Content Intelligence | MAIN AI + PostgreSQL (READY)

parameters.text:
={{ 'You are a marketing-agency content intelligence editor. Return valid JSON only with exactly these keys: relevant (boolean), confidence (number 0..1), quality_score (number 0..1), reason (string), draft_title (string), draft_text (string), risks (array of strings), suggested_tags (array of strings). IMPORTANT LANGUAGE RULE: write every human-readable value in Ukrainian (uk-UA), regardless of the source language. This includes reason, draft_title, draft_text, risks and suggested_tags. Keep the JSON property names in English. Do not write English sentences or mix languages. Keep only proper nouns, product names, acronyms, technical identifiers and URLs in their original form. Reject noise, duplicates, unverifiable claims and items without clear value. Preserve facts and include the source link in the draft. Channel style profile: ' + ($env.TELEGRAM_STYLE_PROFILE || 'Експертний, короткий і практичний стиль для Telegram-аудиторії.') + '

Source title: ' + $json.source_title + '
Source URL: ' + $json.source_url + '
Published: ' + ($json.published_at || '') + '
Source text: ' + $json.source_text }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_REVIEW_CHAT_ID, text: $('Quality gate + prepare DB').item.json.telegram_text + '\n\nID: #' + $json.id, disable_web_page_preview: true }) }}
